en.title: Glory to His Name
en.author: Elisha A. Hoffman
stanzas:
[G]Down at the cross where my [C]Savior [G]died,
Down where for cleansing from sin I [D]cried,
[G]There to my heart was the [C]blood ap[G]plied;
Glory to [D7]His [G]Name!

I am so wondrously saved from sin,
Jesus so sweetly abides within,
There at the cross where He took me in;
Glory to His Name!
en.chorus:
[C]Glory to His [G]Name,
[G]Glory to His [D]Name:
[G]There to my heart was the [C]blood ap[G]plied;
Glory to [D7]His [G]Name!

notes: Text from Timeless Truths (Evening Light Songs #465, Select Hymns 1911 #614), which cites hymnary; four stanzas and refrain, and hymnary's representative text agrees. Often titled 'Down at the Cross'. Tune GLORY TO HIS NAME (John H. Stockton, 1878), meter 9.9.9.5 with refrain. Key: hymnary's instances run 50 A-flat to 7 G; TT prints A-flat. Moved to G for guitar per the key rule. Chords derived from the Timeless Truths MusicXML score by reading the four-part chord on every beat, transposed A-flat to G. The stanza is I with a IV6 neighbour and an augmented passing chord on 'where my' (dropped) into IV on 'Savior', I; line 2 I to V; line 3 as line 1; 'Glory to His Name' a 6/4 into V7, written D7. Refrain: IV, I, I (vii-dim7 and sus4 passing chords on 'Glory to' dropped), V, then line 3 and the cadence as in the stanza.
